_about: H146 fallback memeplexes: the qualitative candidates of #51 (story51 part0-part3, H145 P5 list), fixed as element lists on 2026-10-09 BEFORE any H146 statistic was computed. They are POST HOC (the qualitative reading saw the data). Used only if H145's discovery yields no qualifying memeplex or H145.READY does not appear in time; also used to label H145 memeplexes (overlap) and as a labelled post hoc comparison. Term elements are case-insensitive regular expressions written by the H146 agent (not agent text); an item (chat message) carries a term element if its text matches; an agent expresses it if one of its statements (chat or consolidation intent) matches. Practice elements are repo slugs: an agent expresses one if it touches the project in a call (project_calls.proj, mapped to slugs) in the bin; a chat item carries one if it names the project (project_mentions_chat, slug).
